live_attempt.cause: Terraform attempted application-database and IAM-user deletion concurrently; PostgreSQL rejected each user deletion while privileges still depended on that role, then database deletion succeeded.
live_attempt.resume_fix: Order application-database destruction before IAM-user destruction and skip create/delete transition plans after an interrupted teardown so removed resources are not recreated.
live_attempt.follow_up_result: Cloud SQL and all other runtime resources were deleted; Service Networking rejected connection deletion while Google retained producer resources during its post-delete recovery window.
